Explain this systemd user unit to a colleague in 2-4 plain sentences — what runs, when it restarts, and one operational caveat:

```ini
[Unit]
Description=kvllm — vLLM OpenAI-compatible server (kai RTX 5090)
After=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=exec
WorkingDirectory=/home/ken/src/ai/kvllm
EnvironmentFile=/home/ken/src/ai/kvllm/deploy/kvllm.env
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/uv run python -m kvllm.registry serve ${KVLLM_MODEL_KEY}
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5
TimeoutStartSec=900
KillSignal=SIGTERM
TimeoutStopSec=30

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
```
